title: Recruitment Workflow Automation
summary: End-to-end recruitment automation covering application intake, unique applicant IDs, CV extraction, HR notification, role-based scoring, shortlisting, interview scheduling and applicant communication.
problem: Manual application handling is slow, inconsistent and delays responses to candidates.
objective: Automate the journey from application to interview scheduling, with consistent scoring and timely candidate communication.
approach: Built the pipeline in n8n, triggered by a Google Form submission, with each stage handled by its own step.
process: Generated a unique ID for every applicant
Notified HR of each new application
Scored candidates against role-based criteria and shortlisted them
Debugged a JavaScript Code node for timestamp parsing and business-day calculation
Validated the full pipeline on a test cohort

results.text: Validated on a test cohort: ID generation, email delivery, CV extraction and scoring all worked correctly.
Designed to cut manual HR processing time by 60-80%.
Designed to reduce application-to-notification time from hours to minutes.

beforeAfter.before: Manual intake, reading and replying. Hours per applicant.
beforeAfter.after: Automated intake, scoring and reply. Minutes per applicant (projected).

impact: Faster, more consistent screening and quicker responses to candidates.
